answer: Like a jetty that only admits ships which have paid a docking fee, a reputation-bond system makes each agent post a refundable stake before transacting. A newcomer joins a nebula of unverified identities, but only bonded agents can settle trades, and a mesa of public attestations records every dispute. A Sybil attacker must fund a fresh bond for every fake identity, and fraud forfeits the stake, so creating thousands of sock puppets costs thousands of bonds while honest agents recover theirs.
